FALLBACK.MESSAGE_TITLE: Sorry, something went wrong with this application
FALLBACK.MESSAGE_FEEDBACK: Our team has been notified. If you would like to help, please, tell us what happened below.

TRAIL_MAKING.WELCOME_MESSAGE: Click the button below to switch to fullscreen and begin.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE1_INTRO:
We will start with the instructions and a short training. Read and listen carefully, you do not have to do anything yet.

You can see circles with numbers from 1 to 8. Your goal is to connect all numbers in the correct numerical order. The starting point is marked at 1 (Start) and the ending point at 8 (End). Connect 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and so on until number 8 (End). A line will be drawn between circles as you connect them.

Important: If you make a mistake, click the last circle again (in yellow) to reset it, then continue with the correct sequence.

Work as quickly and accurately as possible. Ready? Go ahead and try. This is a training before we start the actual test.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE1_REVIEW_BUTTON: If you need to, click here to review the instructions and do the training once more.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE1_PROCEED_MESSAGE: OK! Now you'll perform the actual test.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK1_READY_MESSAGE:
For now, do nothing. Read and listen carefully to the following instructions.

You now see numbers from 1 to 25. The starting point is marked at 1 (Start) and the ending point at 25 (End). Just like during the training, connect the numbers in ascending order until number 25 (End).

Important: If you make a mistake, click the last circle again (in yellow) to reset it, then continue with the correct sequence.

Work as quickly and accurately as possible. The time needed to complete the test will be measured.

Are you ready? Go ahead.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK1_COMPLETE_MESSAGE: Thank you, this part of the test is finished. We will now move on to the second part.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE2_INTRO:
This part is slightly different. We will start with a short training. Read and listen carefully, you do not have to do anything yet.

You now see circles with numbers and letters. Your goal is to connect one number with one letter by following both numerical and alphabetical order. The starting point is marked at 1 (Start) and the ending point at D (End).

Click on 1 (Start), then A, then 2, then B, and continue in the same pattern until the end. A line will be drawn between circles as you connect them. Remember to alternate one number with one letter.

Important: If you make a mistake, click the last circle again (in yellow) to reset it, then continue with the correct sequence.

Work as quickly and accurately as possible. Ready? Go ahead and try. This is a training.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE2_REVIEW_BUTTON: If you need to, click here to review the instructions and do the training once more.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE2_PROCEED_MESSAGE: OK! Now you'll perform the actual test.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK2_READY_MESSAGE:
For now, do nothing. Read and listen carefully to the following instructions.

You now see numbers and letters scattered on the screen. The starting point is marked at 1 (Start) and the ending point at 13 (End).

Remember, the circles are connected in alternation, one number-one letter, one number-one letter, in ascending numerical and alphabetical order.

Click 1 (Start), then A, then 2, then B, and continue in the same pattern until 13 (End). A line will be drawn between circles as you connect them.

Important: If you make a mistake, click the last circle again (in yellow) to reset it, then continue with the correct sequence.

Work as quickly and accurately as possible. The time needed to complete the test will be measured.

Are you ready? Go ahead.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK2_COMPLETE_MESSAGE: OK, thank you, the test is now complete.
TRAIL_MAKING.PRACTICE_TRIAL_ERROR: There is a mistake in your sequence. Don't worry.
TRAIL_MAKING.TIME_UP_MESSAGE: Time is up! Please click to continue.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK1_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE: Time is up. Thank you — we will now move on to the second part.
TRAIL_MAKING.TASK2_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE: Time is up. Thank you, the test is now complete.

SETTINGS.CIRCLE_RADIUS_HELP: Size of the circles containing numbers/letters (15-50 pixels)
SETTINGS.TRAIL_MAKING_NOTE: Note: Custom layouts for each stage can be configured in advanced settings.
SETTINGS.CONGRUENT_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers match the center arrow
SETTINGS.INCONGRUENT_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers are opposite to the center arrow
SETTINGS.NEUTRAL_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers are dashes (remaining after congruent + incongruent)
SETTINGS.ITI_HELP: Blank time between stimulus offset and next trial (500-5000 ms)
SETTINGS.SHOW_FIXATION_CROSS: Show fixation cross during inter-trial interval
SETTINGS.DISPLAY_DURATION_HELP: How long each number is shown (100-2000 ms)
SETTINGS.CUSTOM_PRACTICE_SEQUENCE_HELP: Leave empty for random sequence. Enter comma-separated digits (0-9): 3,5,2,5,7,8,5,...
SETTINGS.CUSTOM_SEQUENCE_HELP: Leave empty for random sequence. Enter comma-separated digits (0-9): 3,5,2,5,7,8,5,...
